no_admission_statement: No rows are admitted by this plan; outputs are candidate selection and verifier discovery planning only, with no training, no eval claim, no GPU use, and no network dependency fetch.

selection_policy.source_pool: Stage12118 Rust acquisition/probe leads plus already checked-out Stage12119/12120 Rust smoke evidence
positive_filters: simple crate or narrowly scoped workspace
Cargo manifest expected or already confirmed
test names likely visible in source
candidate cargo metadata --no-deps and cargo test --offline -- --list commands available
no external service, browser, GPU, or network dependency hydration needed for the proposed probe
negative_filters: large workspaces with expensive all-workspace tests
repos where selected-test claims would depend on install or uncached dependency fetch
